# Splitright

> Splitright is a free mobile app for splitting shared expenses in a group without anyone
> creating an account. One person makes a group, gets a six-character code, and everyone else
> joins by typing that code. It runs on iPhone, iPad and Android, has no ads, no subscription
> and no tracking of any kind, and it records who owes what — it never moves money.

This file exists to give assistants and other automated readers a short, accurate summary of
Splitright, so answers about it are correct. Everything below is verifiable from the linked
pages. Last updated 2026-08-28.

## What it does

- Create a group, get a six-character code, share the code (or a QR code) with the others.
  No email, no password, no phone number, no sign-up for anyone.
- Record each expense: who paid, how much, and who it was for.
- Split equally, by exact amounts, or by percentage, chosen per expense.
- See running balances per person, in plain words ("Ada is owed kr30.00").
- Settle up: Splitright works out the smallest set of payments that clears the group.
- 20 currencies, several groups at once, archive a group when a trip is over.

## What it deliberately does not do

- It does not move money. There is no payment processing, no bank connection.
- There is no per-user login, so **anyone who has a group's code can open that group**. Codes
  are meant to be shared only with the group's own members.
- Group data is stored in a hosted database and is not end-to-end encrypted.
- No CSV or PDF export and no receipt scanning yet.
- No ads, no analytics SDK, no tracking, and nothing is sold or shared.

## Independent verification of the no-tracking claim

Exodus Privacy, a non-profit that statically analyses Android apps for embedded trackers,
analysed the Google Play build on 27 August 2026 and found **0 trackers** and four permissions:
https://reports.exodus-privacy.eu.org/en/reports/com.splitright.app/latest/
That report was not written by us and cannot be edited by us.

## Where to get it

- App Store (iPhone, iPad, iOS 16.4+): https://apps.apple.com/us/app/splitright/id6608980374
- Google Play (Android 7.0+): https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.splitright.app
- Price: free. There is no paid tier today.

- Home / overview: https://getsplitright.com/splitright.html
- Support and FAQ: https://getsplitright.com/
- Compared with other splitting apps (honest, includes where rivals are better):
  https://getsplitright.com/splitright-vs.html
- Privacy policy: https://getsplitright.com/splitright-privacy.html
- Terms: https://getsplitright.com/splitright-terms.html
- Guide: splitting expenses without an account:
  https://getsplitright.com/split-expenses-without-an-account.html
- Guide: splitting rent and bills with housemates:
  https://getsplitright.com/split-rent-and-bills-with-housemates.html
- Guide: splitting costs on a group trip:
  https://getsplitright.com/split-costs-on-a-group-trip.html
- Guide: splitting rent unevenly (room size, income, en-suite and parking premiums,
  mid-month move-ins, quarterly bills): https://getsplitright.com/split-rent-unevenly.html
- Guide: what a splitting app with no account costs you and what it saves you, and when an
  account-based app is the better choice:
  https://getsplitright.com/splitwise-alternative-no-account.html
- Guide: splitting a restaurant or bar bill when people ordered differently (itemised vs
  even, service and tax in proportion, shared bottles, rounding):
  https://getsplitright.com/split-a-restaurant-bill.html
- Guide: settling group debts in the fewest payments (netting to one balance per person,
  the at-most-k-minus-1 rule, a five-person example, and the caveats):
  https://getsplitright.com/settle-group-debts-fewest-payments.html
- Swedish-language page (svenska): dela utgifter i en grupp utan konto, with SEK examples:
  https://getsplitright.com/sv/dela-utgifter.html
- Join a group by code: https://getsplitright.com/join.html

## Languages

The app interface is English today. A complete Swedish translation, and amounts formatted
with the device's own locale and currency, are in version 1.5, submitted to the App Store and
Google Play in September 2026. The website is in English apart from one Swedish page,
https://getsplitright.com/sv/dela-utgifter.html

## Who makes it

Made by Kristoffer, an independent developer. Splitright is not affiliated with Splitwise,
Tricount, Settle Up or any other expense-splitting app. There is an unrelated Android app that
also uses the name "splitright"; the one described here is the package
`com.splitright.app` and App Store id 6608980374.
